salmanshh_uidirector.name: UIDirector
salmanshh_uidirector.description: Layer-based UI manager with focus stack, popup system, animations, modal control, and collision management. Track any layer as a named screen, popup, or tooltip - then open, close, and navigate between them with simple actions.

uiContainerLayer.name: UI Container Layer
uiContainerLayer.desc: Name of the group layer in your layout that contains all managed UI sublayers. Example: if your group layer is called "UI", enter "UI" here.

defaultAnimType.name: Default Animation
defaultAnimType.desc: The default transition animation played when showing or hiding a layer. Can be overridden per-layer with Set Layer Animation.

defaultAnimDuration.name: Default Anim Duration (ms)
defaultAnimDuration.desc: How long the default transition animation takes, in milliseconds. Example: 200 = a quick 0.2 second fade.

defaultAnimEasing.name: Default Easing
defaultAnimEasing.desc: The easing curve applied to the default animation. EaseOut feels snappy and responsive; EaseInOut feels smooth.

persistAcrossLayouts.name: Persist Across Layouts
persistAcrossLayouts.desc: If enabled, UIDirector remembers tracked layers and their states when the layout changes. Layer references are re-resolved on the new layout.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.desc: If enabled, UIDirector logs all operations to the browser console (F12 -> Console). Useful during development - turn off before release.

dimLayer.name: Dim Layer
dimLayer.desc: Optional. The name of a layer inside your UI container to use as a dim/scrim overlay. UIDirector will show this layer at the set opacity whenever a modal screen or popup is active, and hide it when none are. Leave blank to disable.

dimOpacity.name: Dim Opacity
dimOpacity.desc: The opacity of the dim layer when it is active (0 = invisible, 1 = fully opaque). Default is 0.5 (50% semi-transparent).

ClosePopup.description: Closes a popup. Use for dismiss or cancel buttons on dialogs.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the popup layer to close.

GoBack.description: Returns to the previous screen, like a Back button. Use for Escape key or back arrows.

HideTip.description: Hides the current tooltip. Use when the mouse leaves a button or item.

OpenPopup.description: Opens a popup above the current screen. Use for confirmation dialogs, rewards, or alerts.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the popup layer to show.

SetupPopupLayer.description: Registers a layer as a popup. Call once at the start for each popup layer like 'Confirm Quit' or 'Error Dialog'.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

SetupScreen.description: Registers a layer as a screen. Call once at the start for each UI screen like 'Main Menu' or 'Settings'.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

SetupTooltipLayer.description: Registers a layer as a tooltip. Call once at the start for each tooltip layer like 'Item Hint' or 'Button Description'.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

ShowScreen.description: Navigates to a screen. The player can press Back to return. Use for menu buttons like 'Settings' or 'Inventory'.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the screen layer to show.

ShowTip.description: Shows a tooltip. Only one can be visible at a time. Use when the mouse hovers over a button or item.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the tooltip layer to show.

NavigateBackToRoot.description: Closes all screens and returns to the very first one. Use for a Home button that jumps straight back to the main menu.

NavigateToScreen.description: Opens a screen and saves the current one in history so the player can go back. Use for navigating into sub-menus.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the screen to navigate to.

NavigateToScreenWithData.display-text: Navigate to screen {0} with data key {1} = {2}
NavigateToScreenWithData.description: Stores data on a screen and opens it in one step. Use to pass info like an item ID before opening a detail screen.

key.name: Key
key.desc: The data key to set before navigating.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value to store under the key.

ReplaceScreen.description: Swaps the current screen for a new one without saving history. The player cannot go back. Use for loading screens or login-to-menu transitions.

ReturnToPreviousScreen.description: Closes the current screen and goes back to the previous one. Use for Back buttons in sub-menus.

ReturnToScreen.description: Goes back to a specific screen, closing everything above it. Pass empty to close all. Use for jumping to the main menu from deep sub-menus.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The layer to pop to. Pass an empty string ("") to clear the entire focus stack.

ResetLayerTimescale.description: Removes all speed overrides set by Set layer timescale. Objects on the layer return to normal game speed, the stored runtime timescale is cleared (won't apply on next open), and if this layer is currently affecting game speed, that is restored immediately.

SetLayerAnimation.display-text: Set layer {0} animation: {1}, {2} ms, {3}, mirror close: {4}
SetLayerAnimation.description: Sets the animation type, speed, easing, and mirror direction for a layer. Use to customize how each screen slides or fades in and out.

type.name: Animation type
type.desc: The type of transition animation to play when this layer opens or closes.

duration.name: Duration (ms)
duration.desc: How long the animation takes in milliseconds.

easing.name: Easing
easing.desc: The easing curve applied to the animation.

mirrorOnBack.name: Mirror close direction
mirrorOnBack.desc: When true, the closing animation plays in the opposite direction to the opening animation. Affects slide and scale animations. Ignored for fade and none.

SetLayerBlocksOthers.description: Sets whether a screen disables all other screens when active. Use to make fullscreen menus block input behind them.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked normal-role layer to modify.

isModal.name: Blocks others
isModal.desc: True = disable all other screens when this one is active. False = leave other screens' interactive states unchanged.

SetLayerData.description: Stores a value on a layer by key name. Use to pass data like an item ID to a detail screen before showing it.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked layer to store data on.

key.name: Key
key.desc: The key name for this data value.

SetLayerInputEnabled.description: Manually turns a layer's input on or off. Use to temporarily disable buttons during an animation or loading.

enable.name: Enabled
enable.desc: True = layer receives pointer/touch input. False = layer ignores input.

SetLayerState.description: Changes a layer to visible, hidden, or disabled with an animation. Use to show or hide HUD elements or grey out a panel.

state.name: State
state.desc: The target state: visible (shown + interactive), hidden (invisible), or disabled (visible but not interactive).

SetLayerTimescale.description: Sets the playback speed of a tracked layer. Instance timescale changes the speed of every object on the layer right now (1 = normal, 0 = frozen, -1 = no change). Runtime timescale is stored and auto-applied to the whole game when this layer opens, then restored when it closes (-1 = off). Tip: instance 1 + runtime 0 keeps the menu animated while the game freezes behind it.

instanceTimescale.name: Instance timescale
instanceTimescale.desc: Per-object timescale multiplier applied to all instances now. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen, 2 = double speed. Use -1 to leave instance timescales unchanged.

runtimeTimescale.name: Runtime timescale
runtimeTimescale.desc: Global runtime timescale to apply automatically when this layer opens, and restore on close. Use -1 to clear or skip the runtime override.

SyncCollisions.description: Auto-disables collision detection on hidden layers. Use to prevent invisible UI buttons from blocking game clicks.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True = automatically manage collisionsEnabled on instances. False = leave collision states unchanged.

CloseAllPopups.description: Closes every open popup at once. Use when switching scenes or clearing all dialogs.

HidePopup.description: Closes a specific popup with its closing animation. Use for Cancel or Close buttons on dialogs.

ShowPopup.description: Opens a popup above all screens. Multiple popups can stack. Use for confirmation dialogs, reward banners, or error messages.

ShowPopupFor.description: Opens a popup that auto-closes after a timer. Use for toast notifications like 'Game Saved' or 'Achievement Unlocked'.

durationMs.name: Duration (ms)
durationMs.desc: How long to keep the popup visible before automatically hiding it, in milliseconds.

HideActiveTooltip.description: Hides whatever tooltip is showing. Safe to call when none is visible. Use on mouse-leave events.

HideTooltip.description: Hides a specific tooltip by name. Use when the mouse leaves a specific item.

ShowTooltip.description: Shows a tooltip. Only one can show at a time — the previous one hides automatically. Use when hovering over items or buttons.

TrackLayer.display-text: Track layer {0} as {1} | Modal: {2} | Manage collisions: {3}
TrackLayer.description: Registers a layer so UIDirector can control it. Call once per layer at the start. Choose its role (screen, popup, or tooltip) and options like blocking input or syncing collisions.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

role.name: Role
role.desc: How UIDirector treats this layer: Normal = screen in the focus stack, Popup = overlay that doesn't affect navigation, Tooltip = display-only overlay always on top.

isModal.name: Modal
isModal.desc: If true, focusing this layer disables all other normal layers' interactivity while it is in focus.

manageCollisions.name: Manage collisions
manageCollisions.desc: If true, collisionsEnabled on all instances on this layer will mirror its interactive state automatically.

UntrackAllLayers.description: Removes all layers from UIDirector and clears all stacks. Use when changing layouts or doing a full UI reset.

UntrackLayer.description: Removes a layer from UIDirector. It keeps its current look but UIDirector stops managing it. Use before destroying a layer.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the layer to stop tracking.

FinishAnimationInstantly.description: Skips a layer's current animation and jumps to the end. Use for skip buttons or when you need a screen ready immediately.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked layer whose transition should be completed immediately.

SkipAllAnimations.description: Skips every layer's animation at once and jumps to their final states. Use for accessibility options or low-performance devices.

CanGoBack.description: True when there is a previous screen to go back to. Use to show or hide a Back button.

OnPopupClosed.description: Triggers when a popup closes. Use to check the player's choice after a confirmation dialog.

OnPopupOpened.description: Triggers when a popup opens. Use to play a sound or dim the background.

OnScreenHidden.description: Triggers when a screen is closed. Use to resume music or clean up after leaving a screen.

OnScreenShown.description: Triggers when a screen becomes active. Use to play a sound or start an intro animation.

NoScreensOpen.description: True when no screens are open. Use to detect when the player has backed out of all menus.

ScreenIsActive.description: True if a screen is the currently active one. Use to show buttons that only appear on a specific screen.

ScreenIsInHistory.description: True if a screen is anywhere in the navigation history. Use to prevent navigating to a screen that is already open.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The screen to search for in the navigation history.

LayerAcceptsInput.description: True if the layer currently accepts clicks and touches. Use to guard button logic so it only runs when the layer is interactive.

LayerBlocksOthers.description: True if this screen blocks input on all other screens when active. Use to check if a dimmed overlay should appear.

LayerIsAnimating.description: True while a layer is playing its transition animation. Use to disable buttons until the screen finishes sliding in.

LayerIsFullyVisible.description: True when a layer is fully open and done animating. Use to only allow button clicks once a screen has completely appeared.

LayerIsInState.description: True if a layer matches a given state (visible, hidden, disabled, focused). Use to check a layer's current state before acting on it.

LayerIsVisible.description: True if the layer is on screen (includes disabled layers). Use to check if a HUD or panel is currently showing.

LayerSyncsCollisions.description: True if collision syncing is turned on for this layer. Use to verify collision management is active.

AnyPopupVisible.description: True when at least one popup is open. Use to dim the background or block input while a dialog is showing.

TooltipIsVisible.description: True when a tooltip is currently showing. Use to suppress other hover effects while a tooltip is up.

LayerIsTracked.description: True if UIDirector is managing this layer. Use as a safety check before calling other actions on it.

OnAnyLayerStateChanged.description: Triggers whenever any layer changes state. Use with LastChangedLayer and LastChangedState for debug logging or global UI tracking.

OnLayerClosing.description: Triggers when a layer starts its closing animation. Use to fade out music or start a parallel exit effect.

OnLayerFullyClosed.description: Triggers after a layer finishes closing. Use to clean up or stop timers once a screen is fully gone.

OnLayerFullyOpened.description: Triggers after a layer finishes opening. Use to enable buttons or start gameplay once a screen is fully visible.

OnLayerOpening.description: Triggers when a layer starts its opening animation. Use to start music or prepare content while the screen slides in.

OnLayerStateChanged.description: Triggers after a specific layer finishes changing state. Use to run logic that depends on the final state, like showing a retry button after Game Over appears.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The layer to watch for state changes.

OnLayerTransitionComplete.description: Triggers when a layer's animation finishes (open or close). Use to enable buttons only after the screen has fully animated in.

CurrentScreen.description: Returns the name of the active screen, or empty if none. Use for debug displays or screen-specific logic.

FocusedLayer.description: Returns the name of the active screen, or empty if none. Use for conditional logic based on which screen is showing.

FocusStackDepth.description: How many screens deep the player is. 0 = none, 1 = one screen, 2+ = deeper. Use for breadcrumbs or depth indicators.

PreviousScreen.description: Returns the name of the screen before the current one. Use for breadcrumbs or 'Back to X' button labels.

ScreenAtDepth.description: Returns the screen name at a specific position in history. 1 = first, 2 = second. Use for building breadcrumb trails.

depth.name: Depth
depth.desc: The position in the navigation history to read. 1 = first screen (bottom of stack), FocusStackDepth() = current top screen.

LayerData.description: Returns a stored value from a layer by key. Use to read data like an item ID that was set before the screen opened.

LayerRole.description: Returns a layer's role: 'normal', 'popup', or 'tooltip'. Use for debug displays.

LayerState.description: Returns a layer's current state: 'visible', 'hidden', 'disabled', or 'focused'. Use for debug displays or conditional logic.

PreviousLayerState.description: Returns the state a layer was in before its last change. Use to restore a layer after a temporary change.

TopPopup.description: Returns the name of the topmost open popup, or empty if none. Use to check which dialog the player is looking at.

ActiveTooltip.description: Returns the name of the visible tooltip, or empty if none. Use for custom logic based on which tooltip is showing.

CountTrackedLayers.description: Returns the total number of layers currently tracked by UIDirector. Use with GetTrackedLayerByIndex in a Repeat loop to iterate all tracked layers.

GetTrackedLayerByIndex.description: Returns the name of a tracked layer at the given zero-based index. Use with CountTrackedLayers in a Repeat loop to iterate all tracked layers.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the tracked layer (0 = first tracked, CountTrackedLayers - 1 = last).

LastChangedLayer.description: Returns which layer most recently changed state. Use inside state-changed triggers to know which layer fired the event.

LastChangedState.description: Returns the new state of the most recently changed layer. Use inside state-changed triggers to react differently to 'hidden' vs 'visible'.

LayerAnimDirection.description: Returns 'opening', 'closing', or empty. Use to play different sounds based on whether a screen is coming in or going out.

LayerAnimProgress.description: Returns the animation progress from 0 to 1. Use to sync custom effects like fading music with a screen's transition.
